name: Lady Pumpkin the Halloween Witch
text:
2 Level 7+ Spellcaster Monsters
If this card is Fusioned Summoned you can target up to 2 Spellcaster monsters from your GY. then you can target an equal number of cards that were banished, negate their effects and put 1 Pumpkin counters on each monster. This card can attack monsters with Pumpkin counters once each. During the End Phase if this card was sent to the GY Special Summon this card. This card cannot be Banished.
